environment.description: Same ECS Fargate task in private subnet but S3 traffic is forced through a Gateway VPC Endpoint (vpce-0a1b2c3d4e5f67890) with an endpoint policy. The endpoint policy uses a Condition block with StringEquals on s3:prefix and restricts the Resource element. Route table for the private subnet has a prefix list entry (pl-63a5400a) directing all S3 traffic through the VPC endpoint - there is no NAT gateway route for S3 CIDR ranges. The endpoint policy document specifies Allow only for s3:PutObject where the resource ARN matches arn:aws:s3:::prod-data-ingestion-raw/incoming/* with an additional condition requiring aws:PrincipalOrgID equals o-abc123def4.

config.network: Private subnet, route table rtb-0f1e2d3c4b5a has pl-63a5400a -> vpce-0a1b2c3d4e5f67890
config.nat_gateway: No NAT gateway route for S3 prefix list CIDRs
